import itertools,json
from fractions import Fraction as F
states=list(itertools.product((0,1),repeat=2))
def encoded(x): return {"numerator":str(x.numerator),"denominator":str(x.denominator)}
def mv(matrix,v): return [sum(p*x for p,x in zip(row,v)) for row in matrix]
checked=[]
for q in (F(1,2),F(19,47)):
    for e in (F(0),F(1,20),F(1,10)):
        for beta in (F(-1,2),F(0),F(1,2)):
            alpha=(1-beta)*e/(1-q)
            pair={(0,0):(1-q)**2+q*e,(0,1):q*(1-q-e),(1,0):q*(1-q-e),(1,1):q*(q+e)}
            pi=[pair[s] for s in states]
            rates=[q+alpha*(s[1]-q)+beta*(s[0]-q) for s in states]
            Q=[[F(0) if t[0]!=s[1] else p if t[1] else 1-p for t in states] for s,p in zip(states,rates)]
            assert all(0<p<1 for p in rates) and all(p>0 for p in pi) and sum(pi)==1
            assert all(sum(row)==1 for row in Q)
            assert all(sum(pi[i]*Q[i][j] for i in range(4))==pi[j] for j in range(4))
            Q2=[[sum(Q[i][k]*Q[k][j] for k in range(4)) for j in range(4)] for i in range(4)]
            assert all(p>0 for row in Q2 for p in row)
            assert sum(pi[i]*s[0] for i,s in enumerate(states))==q
            assert sum(pi[i]*s[1] for i,s in enumerate(states))==q
            assert sum(pi[i]*s[0]*s[1] for i,s in enumerate(states))/q-q==e
            entry={"q":encoded(q),"effect":encoded(e),"beta":encoded(beta),"minimum_transition":encoded(min(rates)),"mixing_two_step_min":encoded(min(p for row in Q2 for p in row))}
            if e==0:
                score=[(F(a)-q)*(F(b)-q)/q for a,b in states]
                h=[x/(1-beta) for x in score]
                Qh=mv(Q,h)
                assert [x-y for x,y in zip(h,Qh)]==score
                variance=sum(p*x*x for p,x in zip(pi,score))
                lrv=2*sum(p*x*y for p,x,y in zip(pi,score,h))-variance
                assert variance==(1-q)**2
                assert lrv==variance*(1+beta)/(1-beta)
                entry["score_poisson_lrv"]=encoded(lrv)
                entry["score_lrv_ratio"]=encoded(lrv/variance)
            checked.append(entry)
q=F(19,47)
cross=F(0)
for a,b,c in itertools.product((0,1),repeat=3):
    mass=q**(a+b+c)*(1-q)**(3-a-b-c)
    first=(a-q)*(b-q)/q
    second=(b-q)*(c-q)/q
    cross+=mass*first**2*second**2
squared_score_covariance=cross-(1-q)**4
assert squared_score_covariance==(1-q)**3*(1-2*q)**2/q>0
assert next(x for x in checked if x["q"]==encoded(q) and x["effect"]==encoded(F(1,10)) and x["beta"]==encoded(F(-1,2)))["minimum_transition"]==encoded(F(121,26320))
print(json.dumps({"status":"PASS","method":"independent four-state stride-two kernel; exact Poisson equation at null; positive two-step transition matrix","checked_extension_cells":len(checked),"null_poisson_checks":6,"squared_score_covariance_at_lag2_when_outcomes_iid":encoded(squared_score_covariance),"cases":checked,"simulated_worlds":0,"market_data_read":False,"scientific_readiness":False},indent=2))
